concept_name: Coastal Swift 24 — electric hydrofoil passenger catamaran

mission.mission_statement: A high-utilisation short-route passenger craft with predictable ride quality, accessible boarding, rapid turnaround, low local emissions and a fail-safe return-to-port capability.
mission.operating_region: Sheltered/coastal routes only after a route-specific sea-state and refuge analysis; open-ocean operation is not assumed.
mission.route_profile: Frequent short legs, scheduled dwell/charging, wave/current variation, passenger boarding and accessible pier interfaces.

target_cruise_speed_kn.rationale: Concept performance target lower than the 38-kn project figure publicly reported for EF-24; not a prediction or guaranteed capability.

target_range_nmi.rationale: Provisional operating range includes reserve and degradation review; battery mass/energy closure unproven.

voyage_duration_days.rationale: High-utilisation daily-service profile rather than overnight mission.

passenger_capacity.rationale: Working capacity inspired by public EF-24 project comparator; arrangement/evacuation not evaluated.

crew_capacity.rationale: Set through vessel operations, manning and applicable rules.

payload_capacity.rationale: Battery mass, passengers, baggage, accessible boarding system and structural margins need a full weight budget.

length_overall_m.rationale: Comparable length tier to the public EF-24 project; this concept has no copied geometry.

length_waterline_m.rationale: Foilborne and displacement-mode waterlines differ; define hull references explicitly.

overall_beam_m.rationale: Set by passenger layout, docking envelope, foil span, stability and structural loads.

demihull_beam_m.rationale: Optimize submerged-volume, takeoff power, low-speed operation and foiling drag.

hull_centerline_spacing_m.rationale: Tune for hull wave interference, transverse structure, foil geometry, pier access and stability.

hull_spacing_over_lwl.rationale: Dimensionless design variable requiring coupled hydrostatic, hydrodynamic and structural analysis.

design_draft_m.rationale: Must include hullborne mode, foils/struts, retractability, grounding and port/charging access.

wet_deck_clearance_m.rationale: Must pass non-foiling/slamming modes and transitional takeoff/landing conditions.

wet_deck_clearance_over_draft.rationale: Compare over loading, foilborne transition and waves.

displacement_tonnes.rationale: Must close passenger payload, battery, propulsion, structural and reserve masses.

demihull_slenderness_lwl_over_beam.rationale: Optimize with takeoff drag, low-speed resistance, structure and passenger space.

geometry.hull_form_hypothesis: Compare slender foil-compatible demi-hulls, transitional hullborne resistance and takeoff/landing bow volumes.
geometry.volume_distribution_hypothesis: Need sufficient reserve buoyancy and predictable transition response without assuming foilborne mode is always available.

hydrodynamics.hull_interference_method: Evaluate hull-to-hull wave interference in hullborne modes plus foil-to-foil, strut and hull interaction; use matched non-foil and foil configurations.
hydrodynamics.resistance_method: Build separate low-speed hullborne, takeoff/transition and foilborne power curves with appendage/propulsor interaction and uncertainty.
hydrodynamics.propulsor_configuration: Compare redundant electric waterjets or suitable propulsors with efficiency, cavitation, manoeuvring, noise and fouling evaluated; final type remains open.
hydrodynamics.foil_configuration: Fully foiling with retractability or safe fail-operational mode is a candidate, not a selected architecture; analyse control failure, impact, fouling and partial-lift states.
reference_cases: Public EF-24 project dimensions/performance only as a project-reported comparator; no geometry/energy-saving claim transferred.
Delft 372 research as a monohull/catamaran interference and validation-method anchor, not direct foil performance data.
hydrodynamics.uncertainty_method: Propagate battery capacity, vessel mass, foil/propulsion efficiency, waves, passenger payload and degradation; validate each regime independently.

seakeeping.wave_climate_basis: Define the exact high-utilisation coastal route sea-state distribution and threshold for foilborne service versus hullborne safe return.
seakeeping.wet_deck_impact_method: Analyse hullborne and transition states; foilborne lift cannot be used to waive slamming/impact checks while the hull or foils encounter waves.
seakeeping.ride_comfort_method: Use acceleration distributions, jerk and motion/comfort indicators over actual route spectra; verify with model tests and passenger-trial methods where permitted.

structure_and_safety.cross_deck_load_path: Design for foil/strut loads, asymmetric lift, propulsor thrust, cross-deck torsion, wave slam, fatigue and potential impact loads.
structure_and_safety.fatigue_method: Variable-amplitude wave, foil-cycle, start/stop and docking loads with inspectability/maintenance assumptions.
structure_and_safety.asymmetric_flooding_method: Evaluate hull compartmentation, asymmetric flooding, post-damage residual stability, watertight and accessible evacuation arrangements.
structure_and_safety.stability_method: Apply vessel/route-appropriate high-speed craft, intact stability and damage/stability criteria as confirmed by flag/class; account for foil lift and failure states.
structure_and_safety.foil_failure_mode_method: Explicit failure modes for sensor/control/power loss, foil strike/fouling, asymmetric lift, actuator jam and emergency transition to hullborne operation.
structure_and_safety.redundancy_and_degraded_modes: Independent critical control/power paths; demonstrate reduced-speed hullborne return where physically possible and define weather/range limits when it is not.
structure_and_safety.approval_basis: Determine HSC Code applicability based on speed, voyage, refuge times, vessel classification and route; compliance is not inferred from this concept record.

propulsion_candidates: battery-electric foilborne with hullborne limp-home reserve
battery-electric with shore charging and route dispatch
hybrid variant only if full lifecycle/local-emission trade demonstrates mission need

battery_capacity_mwh.rationale: Calculate from regime-specific power/time histories, route duty cycle, reserve, degradation, thermal systems, charge efficiency and battery mass.

energy_architecture.mode_resolved_load_basis: Separate standby/boarding, displacement departure, foiling acceleration, cruise, deceleration/docking, charging, HVAC, hotel and degraded return modes.
energy_architecture.shore_power_or_charging: Route-constrained charging model must include charger power, berth dwell, queue, connector/port availability, grid outage and seasonal emission factor.
energy_architecture.renewable_assist: Onboard solar is likely auxiliary at this speed scale; quantify net contribution after area, mass, shading and maintenance rather than claim primary energy.
energy_architecture.emissions_boundary: Report no onboard combustion separately from well-to-wake grid emissions and battery manufacture/replacement; do not equate electric with zero lifecycle emissions.
energy_architecture.reserve_policy: Define safe return reserve for wave-related foil restrictions, route deviation, charger failure, degraded battery and hullborne power.

payload_and_operations.mission_payload: Passenger seating, baggage, accessibility, crew, emergency equipment, battery systems and structural margins are in one mass/space budget.
payload_and_operations.port_or_mooring_envelope: Confirm passenger accessibility, fendering, mooring, foil/strut clearance, draft, charging connection and emergency access.
payload_and_operations.maintainability: Foils, struts, actuators, underwater sensors and electric drives need inspection and replacement intervals with fault detection and spare parts.
payload_and_operations.crew_workload: Design bridge/foil control with mode annunciation, overrides, alarm prioritization and clear weather/transition procedures.
payload_and_operations.emergency_access: Safe passenger egress, life-saving appliances, evacuation in low-freeboard/high-speed layout and post-control-failure shelter/refuge strategy.

availability_target.rationale: Provisional route-service goal; weather and charger availability are included, not excluded implicitly.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Matched route/speed, passenger load, weather gate, reserve and access service.
performance_targets.validation_method: Independently validated duty-cycle energy model and measured pilot-vessel/sea-trial data.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Same route accessibility, payload, reserve and operational availability.
performance_targets.validation_method: Full-scale sea trials across specified loading and environmental conditions.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Battery-electric service; upstream energy and charging losses disclosed separately.
performance_targets.validation_method: Energy metering and complete route/charging ledger.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Sensor/actuator/power failure, partial foil, impact, out-of-envelope and loss-of-lift controls.
performance_targets.validation_method: Fault injection, hardware-in-loop and model tests plus qualified operating-envelope review.

hard_constraints.description: Determine and meet the applicable HSC Code and other statutory requirements for vessel/route.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Formal applicability matrix, flag/class engagement, and documented compliance evidence.

hard_constraints.description: Foil/strut/actuator structural strength, fatigue, impact and corrosion safety.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Qualified structural load cases, materials assessment, NDT and maintenance plan.

hard_constraints.description: Control/actuator/power fault cannot create an uncontained unsafe condition.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: FMEA/FMECA, fault injection, hardware-in-loop and demonstrated degraded modes.

hard_constraints.description: Required route plus reserve closes at full passenger load and expected battery degradation.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Traceable mode-resolved route-energy model, uncertainty analysis and battery validation.

hard_constraints.description: Accessible boarding, passenger seating, evacuation, lifesaving and rescue envelope.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Applicable-rule design review and demonstrated evacuation/equipment access.

hard_constraints.description: Declare safe operating thresholds and prohibit use beyond unsupported wave/current conditions.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Route-specific wave and refuge study with verified operational procedures.

assumptions.statement: Foilborne lift can materially reduce total route energy against a conventional catamaran on this mission.
assumptions.falsification_method: Compare total electric energy from boarding to berth including takeoff, propulsion, foil drag, waves, ancillary loads and reserve.

assumptions.statement: The target range can close at the design speed while retaining safe reserve in degraded hullborne mode.
assumptions.falsification_method: Battery mass-energy closure with high-fidelity power/time profiles, battery aging and harsh route cases.

assumptions.statement: Foil-control faults can transition to a safe hullborne/limp-home mode for all declared design cases.
assumptions.falsification_method: Fault-injection matrix for asymmetric lift, sensor dropout, actuator jam, impact, power loss and wave boundary.

provenance.title: CFD validation for Delft 372 Catamaran in static drift conditions
provenance.scope: Reference methodology for calm-water drift, loads, sinkage/trim, PIV and wave-pattern validation; geometry/conditions must match before quantitative use.

provenance.title: Experimental catamaran head-wave benchmark with uncertainty quantification
provenance.scope: Regular and irregular head-wave responses and statistical uncertainty analysis; source record notes access restrictions, so do not redistribute source data without permission.

provenance.title: ITTC CFD validation benchmark database for resistance and propulsion
provenance.scope: Procedure describing selection and use of resistance/propulsion CFD validation cases; not blanket permission to redistribute linked data.

provenance.title: IMO High-speed craft safety framework
provenance.scope: Applicability and overview of HSC Code for qualifying high-speed craft; route and vessel-specific applicability review required.

provenance.title: IMO ship design and stability
provenance.scope: Public overview of SOLAS ship design, subdivision and stability requirements; not a complete compliance checklist.

provenance.title: Condor/Artemis EF-24 electric ferry project report
provenance.scope: Project-reported 24 m hydrofoil ferry concept with up to 150 passengers, 100 nmi and 38 kn; comparison anchor only, not independent validation.

claim_ceiling: Concept hypothesis only. The EF-24 is a public project comparator; its reported speeds/range/energy claims are not independent validation of this design. No passenger-carrying approval or safe foilborne envelope is established.
